description: Defines an abstract class 'AbstractDisplayField' within the OrangeHRM namespace, representing a generic display field entity for report/grouping purposes, with properties for field attributes and ORM mappings.

classes.name: AbstractDisplayField
classes.description: An abstract base class for display fields, containing properties like name, label, width, associations to report groups and display field groups, along with getters and setters for these properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Abstract method to get the unique identifier of the display field.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Abstract method to set the unique identifier of the display field.

methods.name: getReportGroup
methods.description: Returns the associated ReportGroup entity.

methods.name: setReportGroup
methods.description: Sets the associated ReportGroup entity.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the display field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the display field.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the display field.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label of the display field.

methods.name: getFieldAlias
methods.description: Returns the alias of the field, if any.

methods.name: setFieldAlias
methods.description: Sets the alias for the field.

methods.name: isSortable
methods.description: Checks if the field is sortable.

methods.name: setSortable
methods.description: Sets whether the field is sortable.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the sort order of the field.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order of the field.

methods.name: getSortField
methods.description: Returns the sort field.

methods.name: setSortField
methods.description: Sets the sort field.

methods.name: getElementType
methods.description: Returns the element type of the display field.

methods.name: setElementType
methods.description: Sets the element type of the display field.

methods.name: getElementProperty
methods.description: Returns the element property.

methods.name: setElementProperty
methods.description: Sets the element property.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the display element.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of the display element.

methods.name: isExportable
methods.description: Checks if the field is exportable.

methods.name: setExportable
methods.description: Sets whether the field is exportable.

methods.name: getTextAlignmentStyle
methods.description: Returns the text alignment style.

methods.name: setTextAlignmentStyle
methods.description: Sets the text alignment style.

methods.name: isValueList
methods.description: Checks if the field is a value list.

methods.name: setIsValueList
methods.description: Sets whether the field is a value list.

methods.name: getDisplayFieldGroup
methods.description: Returns the associated DisplayFieldGroup entity.

methods.name: setDisplayFieldGroup
methods.description: Sets the associated DisplayFieldGroup entity.

methods.name: getDefaultValue

methods.name: setMeta
methods.description: Sets whether the field is marked as meta.
